title: autograder-setup — Rust CLI for GitHub Classroom Autograding
prefeaturesdescription: A tiny Rust CLI that bootstraps autograding for GitHub Classroom Rust assignments with zero hassle.
features: One-minute setup: parse AST for tests and generate a ready-to-run Actions workflow
Markdown grading tables copied to clipboard or injected into README
Precompiled CI YAML for faster, cheaper grading runs
postfeaturesdescription: Deployed in Boston University's Intro to Rust course (130+ students, 1000+ repos)
